primary_sources.note: Human aortic smooth muscle cells (HASMCs) vascular remodeling in microgravity
Bone tissue extracellular matrix and immune remodeling in spaceflight

consequences.label: Musculoskeletal Deconditioning & Bone Density Loss
consequences.evidence_summary: Reduced mechanical loading in microgravity drives bone mineral density loss and skeletal muscle atrophy.

consequences.label: Cardiovascular Deconditioning & Fluid Shifts
consequences.evidence_summary: Altered gravity alters vascular smooth muscle signaling, cardiac workload, and orthostatic tolerance.

limitations: OSDR model-organism and cellular studies inform physiological mechanisms only; they are not live astronaut vital signs or clinical thresholds.
